en: Illustrated historic view of a large urban square with a fountain, horse-drawn trams and early motor vehicles. Prominent in the foreground is a corner building with the name "ANTON OBLACK" on the facade, showing many pedestrians and shoppers. Surrounding the square are multi‑storey buildings and tree‑lined streets. In the lower right corner there is an inset interior view of a sales hall filled with neatly stacked goods. The caption text at the bottom identifies the scene as Bismarckplatz in Graz and advertises the Anton Oblack outfitting store.
